comment: Which model and effort each role of a delivery run uses, and what a model costs. The skills dispatch each role through the agent named in `agent`; effort can only be set in an agent's own definition, so a role with its own model or effort has its own agent file, and tests/retro/models.test.mjs keeps the two in step. The code reads this file through lib/retro/models.mjs. The retro may propose a change here from the runs ledger, but never makes one: a model swap is always a large change. `edits` marks a role that changes code or data files; a Sonnet role that edits runs a real check (tests, typecheck, build or the named delivery check) before it reports done. `phase` is where the ledger counts the role's time and cost.

main.about: the main session: runs the run, decides, triages, opens PRs

rules.about: rules agent (briefs/rules.md): one rule per stated behaviour

extractor.about: design inventory, words, intent and scope-reply extraction

contract.about: labels each text of the data contract data, fixed words or random (briefs/contract-labeller.md); the texts come from the design DOM

steers.about: writes steers.md from the design before round 1 (briefs/steers.md): phone patterns, fixture names, rules over the picture

mapper.about: writes map.json, checklist.md and the world files (briefs/mapper.md)

seed-writer.about: writes and fixes the fixture world files

builder.check: the repo's typecheck and the page's tests
builder.about: the first build of a page from the pictures; keeps .delivery/<f>/builder-notes.md

fix-builder.check: the repo's typecheck and the page's tests
fix-builder.about: one fresh builder per fix round, given the round's review.json and builder-notes.md

reviewer.about: compares live and design pictures, with delivery crop for close looks

sorter.about: sorts findings into bug, data gap or known steer; not dispatched yet (the main session sorts until a sorter agent is measured)

ci-fixer.about: fixes a CI failure after the PR opens, given the failing log

unit-builder.about: full mode: one unit of the plan

contract-builder.about: full mode: the contract unit and high-risk units

auditor.about: full mode: compares captures with the design, with delivery crop
